# Overlapping captures (synthetic, #474)

Four notes pages of what is really one notebook page of *La comunicación*, captured the way a
student does it (the real case: lengua/la-comunicacion, nine captures of one page):

- `page-001.md`: the list of the elements of communication; the photo is cut at the bottom edge
  (triage `partial`, low sharpness), so the channel's example is uncertain and the code's
  definition illegible.
- `page-002.md`: the same list photographed again, sharper, read slightly differently; it reads
  the channel's example and the code's definition with no uncertainty mark, and adds nothing else.
- `page-003.md`: the list's last element (context), then the review scheme.
- `page-004.md`: page 3 photographed again, read slightly differently: adds nothing new.

`reference.md` is the notes the editor should end with after incorporating the four pages in
order: every idea once, the uncertain fragments filled from page 2, the scheme from page 3, and
nothing from page 4. `pages.json` gives each page's sidecar triage metadata (status, reasons,
sharpness).
